basic_details.job_title: NSPCL Field Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 17 Posts
basic_details.short_information: NTPC-SAIL Power Company Limited (NSPCL), a joint venture of NTPC and SAIL, is engaging 17 Field Engineers (Power Station – O&M, Civil and Safety) on a fixed term basis for up to 3 years initially, at a monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 90,000/- plus company accommodation/HRA and medical facility. Candidates need an engineering degree with at least 60% marks and minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience. Under Advertisement 03/2026, applications are accepted only online on the NSPCL website from 20 November 2026 (from 10:00 AM) to 4 December 2026 (till 11:59 PM).

content_sections.heading: About NSPCL
content_sections.text: NTPC-SAIL Power Company Limited (NSPCL) describes itself as a Premier Joint Venture Company of two Maharatnas, NTPC Limited and SAIL, with its office at 4th Floor, NBCC Tower, 15 Bhikaiji Cama Place, New Delhi. NSPCL has Business Units at Bhilai, Durgapur and Rourkela with a total installed capacity of 1119 MW, and supplies power to SAIL Units, the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, the Union Territory of Daman & Diu and Chhattisgarh State.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Abbreviations as printed: D = Deaf, HH = Hard of Hearing, OA = One Arm, OL = One Leg, Dw = Dwarfism, AAV = Acid Attack Victims, LC = Leprosy Cured, CP = Cerebral Palsy, SLD = Specific Learning Disability, MI = Mental Illness, ASD = Autism Spectrum Disorder (M = Mild), MD = Multiple Disabilities. Reservations and concessions for PwBD apply for a degree of disability of 40% or above.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are eligible. All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India, and SC/ST/PwBD candidates with passing marks in the qualifying degree are also eligible to apply. Field Engineer (Power Station - Safety) needs both: Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Civil / Production / Chemical / Construction / Instrumentation Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with not less than 60% marks, and Diploma / Advance Diploma / PG Diploma in Industrial Safety from Central Labour Institute / Regional Labour Institute, Govt. of India. Age, experience and qualification are all computed with reference to the last date of receipt of online applications. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification. Where a vacancy is identified for the category, the upper age limit is relaxed as follows. The age limit after all applicable relaxations shall not exceed 55 years as on the date of application. Candidates claiming a category must hold a valid EWS/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/SC/ST/Disability certificate from the competent authority, in the latest prescribed format of the Government of India. Candidates should have sound health. Before joining, they must undergo a medical examination at any of the NSPCL notified/empanelled/project hospitals, and the decision of NSPCL will be final. No relaxation in health standards is allowed; detailed medical norms are on the NSPCL website ( https://www.nspcl.co.in/page/10 ).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three Field Engineer posts carry the same compensation package: Monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 90,000/-; income tax and statutory benefits are deducted as applicable from the consolidated amount. Additionally, company accommodation/HRA, night shift entertainment allowance (if applicable), and medical facility for self, spouse, dependent parents and two children. For HRA, TA/DA etc., admissibility is at par with E2 Grade entitlement. On official tour, the company will reimburse TA/DA as applicable. The Fixed Term Engagement is up to a period of 3 years initially and can be extended up to 2 years based on organizational requirements and the performance of the FTE. Posting shall be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NSPCL, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NSPCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: No manual or paper application will be entertained. The online application window opens on 20 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Apply online on the website https://www.nspcl.co.in/page/10 . Read the instructions and fill in the online application form with accurate information, including an e-mail ID that will stay valid for at least one year. Upload your photograph and signature, and upload all documents while applying. After successful registration, keep the printout of the Registration slip showing the Unique Registration Number. General category candidates pay the non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 300/- online through Net banking / Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI; SC/ST/PwBD/XSM and female candidates need not pay. Download the application slip with the unique application number; no document is to be sent to NSPCL by post. Photograph and signature. Valid EWS/SC/ST/Disability/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate from the competent authority, where applicable. For private sector experience, pay is verified from: work experience certificate; yearly compensation statements or other pay-related statements (if available); at least 2-3 salary slips per year (including start and end of the year) with additional slips for variable/special payments; Form 16 and ITR. For experience in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU/Autonomous bodies/Co-operative establishments: a copy of the online application through proper channel with NOC, or NOC from the present employer at the time of interview. Applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for a Personal Interview based on merit and the requirement of the post. To restrict the number of candidates, the management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process, which may comprise application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, years of post-qualification experience etc.), a written/computer-based test, a personal interview or a combination of these, or to raise the minimum eligibility standards. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not give a candidate the right to be shortlisted or called for a test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 posts: 12 Field Engineer (Power Station - O&M), 4 Field Engineer (Power Station - Civil) and 1 Field Engineer (Power Station - Safety).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NSPCL Field Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 4 December 2026 (till 11:59 PM); applications open on 20 November 2026 from 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NSPCL Field Engineer?
faq.answer: An engineering degree in the branches specified for each post with at least 60% marks (pass marks for SC/ST/PwBD), plus minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience; the Safety post also needs a Diploma / Advance Diploma / PG Diploma in Industrial Safety from Central Labour Institute / Regional Labour Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NSPCL Field Engineer?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years for the O&M and Civil posts and 45 years for the Safety post, as on the last date of online application, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwBD up to a ceiling of 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NSPCL Field Engineer?
faq.answer: The pay is a monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 90,000/-, plus company accommodation/HRA, night shift entertainment allowance (if applicable) and medical facility for self, spouse, dependent parents and two children.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General category candidates pay a non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 300/- online; SC/ST/PwBD/XSM and female candidates need not pay.

faq.question: Q7. How will NSPCL select Field Engineers?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for a Personal Interview based on merit and the requirement of the post, and NSPCL reserves the right to use multi-stage selection such as screening or a written/computer-based test.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NSPCL Field Engineer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a Fixed Term Engagement of up to 3 years initially, which can be extended up to 2 years based on organizational requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one Field Engineer post in NSPCL?
faq.answer: No, a candidate can apply for one post only; if more than one application is made, only the last application will be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to send a hard copy of the NSPCL application?
faq.answer: No, applications are accepted only online and no document is required to be sent by post; all documents must be uploaded while applying.
